evidence.excerpt: Across continuous-control benchmarks spanning dense locomotion, sparse navigation, and contact-rich manipulation, BFM-QD consistently outperforms parameter-space baselines, with particularly stark gains in sparse and deceptive settings, where all tested parameter-space QD methods collapse to near-zero performance.
